nodes.description: Token name string stored in contract storage, written by constructor.
Token symbol string stored in contract storage, written by constructor.
Token decimals (default 18), read in constructor to scale initial supply.
Total token supply; mutated by constructor, burn and burnFrom without SafeMath.
Mapping address => balance; updated by _transfer, burn and burnFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => amount; updated by approve, transferFrom, burnFrom.
Constructor mints initialSupply*10**decimals to msg.sender and sets name/symbol.
Internal transfer routine updating balanceOf mappings and emitting Transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer from msg.sender to _to, delegates to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Approves spender then invokes receiveApproval external callback on the spender contract.
Burns _value tokens from msg.sender and decreases totalSupply.
Burns _value tokens from _from using msg.sender allowance and decreases totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as owner/authenticator in most functions.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender,_value,address(this),_extraData) to an arbitrary user-supplied contract; reentrancy vector.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in _transfer without SafeMath (underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value in _transfer without SafeMath (overflow risk).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value in burn without SafeMath.
totalSupply -= _value in burn without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in burnFrom without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in burnFrom without SafeMath.
totalSupply -= _value in burnFrom without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath.
totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in constructor without SafeMath.
Constructor parameter: initial token amount before decimal scaling.
Constructor parameter: token name string.
Constructor parameter: token symbol string.
_transfer parameter: source address of the transfer.
_transfer parameter: destination address of the transfer.
_transfer parameter: amount of tokens moved.
transfer parameter: recipient address.
transfer parameter: amount of tokens moved.
transferFrom parameter: address tokens are taken from.
transferFrom parameter: recipient address.
transferFrom parameter: amount of tokens moved.
approve parameter: address authorized to spend.
approve parameter: allowance amount.
approveAndCall parameter: spender contract that is also the callback target.
approveAndCall parameter: allowance amount.
approveAndCall parameter: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the callback.
burn parameter: amount of tokens to destroy.
burnFrom parameter: account whose tokens are burned.
burnFrom parameter: amount of tokens to destroy.
_transfer local: sum of both balances captured before mutation and checked with assert.
approveAndCall local: tokenRecipient instance wrapping the user-supplied _spender address.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter initialSupply is multiplied to compute totalSupply without overflow protection.
Constructor parameter tokenName is written to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol is written to the symbol state variable.
_from selects the balanceOf mapping slot read and debited in _transfer.
_to selects the balanceOf mapping slot credited in _transfer.
_value drives both unchecked balance subtractions and additions in _transfer.
transfer forwards _to into the internal _transfer call.
transfer forwards _value into the internal _transfer call.
_from is used to look up allowance and balanceOf in transferFrom.
_to is forwarded to _transfer inside transferFrom.
_value is compared against allowance then subtracted without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_spender is the key written into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient and used as the external callback target.
_value is passed to approve and to the external receiveApproval call.
_extraData is forwarded as arbitrary calldata to the external callback.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf and totalSupply without SafeMath in burn.
_from selects the balanceOf and allowance entries affected by burnFrom.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf, allowance and totalSupply unchecked in burnFrom.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
transfer spends tokens of the caller identity msg.sender.
transferFrom authorizes spending through allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance under msg.sender as owner.
approveAndCall approves tokens on behalf of the calling msg.sender.
burn only destroys tokens belonging to msg.sender.
burnFrom requires allowance[_from][msg.sender] and is keyed on the caller.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
Constructor performs initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) which can overflow.
Unchecked multiplication result is written directly into totalSupply.
_transfer executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
_transfer executes balanceOf[_to] += _value with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf state mapping.

Unchecked subtraction writes to balanceOf.
burn executes totalSupply -= _value unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes to totalSupply.
burnFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes to balanceOf.
burnFrom executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes to allowance.
burnFrom executes totalSupply -= _value unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes to totalSupply.
transferFrom executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes to allowance.
Attacker-controlled _value is subtracted from a balance without SafeMath.
Attacker-controlled _value is added to a balance without SafeMath.
User-supplied burn amount flows into an unchecked balance subtraction.
User-supplied burn amount flows into an unchecked totalSupply subtraction.
User-supplied amount flows into unchecked balance subtraction in burnFrom.
User-supplied amount flows into unchecked allowance subtraction in burnFrom.
User-supplied amount flows into unchecked totalSupply subtraction in burnFrom.
User-supplied amount flows into unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
User-supplied initialSupply feeds the unchecked supply multiplication.
_from indexes the balance debited by unchecked subtraction.
_to indexes the balance credited by unchecked addition.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
approveAndCall performs a nested external call to the public approve function.
approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary external contract via receiveApproval.
The callee contract can re-enter approveAndCall/approve while state is already modified.
Constructor writes tokenName into the name state variable.
Constructor writes tokenSymbol into the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the computed supply to totalSupply.
Constructor mints the supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor reads decimals to scale the initial supply.
_transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance.
transferFrom triggers balanceOf mutations through _transfer.
approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
approveAndCall modifies allowance through the nested approve call.
burn reads and decrements balanceOf[msg.sender].
burn decrements totalSupply.
burnFrom reads and decrements balanceOf[_from].
burnFrom decrements the caller allowance.
burnFrom decrements totalSupply.
_transfer stores the pre-mutation balance sum in the previousBalances local used by assert.
approveAndCall instantiates the tokenRecipient local from the _spender argument.
The user-supplied tokenRecipient local is the target of the unguarded external call.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter initialSupply is only meaningful as input to the constructor body.
Constructor parameter tokenName only feeds the constructor assignment to name.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol only feeds the constructor assignment to symbol.
_from parameter of the internal transfer routine should be folded into _transfer.
_to parameter of the internal transfer routine should be folded into _transfer.
_value parameter drives the unchecked balance updates inside _transfer.
transfer recipient argument is only used to forward into _transfer.
transfer amount argument is only used to forward into _transfer.
transferFrom source argument is a local binding of the external call.
transferFrom recipient argument is a local binding of the external call.
transferFrom amount argument drives the unchecked allowance subtraction.
approve spender argument is a local binding used to key the allowance mapping.
approve value argument is the amount written into allowance.
approveAndCall spender argument is locally cast and used as callback target.
approveAndCall value argument is forwarded to approve and the callback.
approveAndCall extraData argument is opaque calldata forwarded to the callback.
burn amount argument only feeds the unchecked balance and supply subtractions.
burnFrom source argument is a local binding of the external call.
burnFrom amount argument drives the unchecked subtractions in burnFrom.
previousBalances exists only inside _transfer as a sanity-check temporary.
The tokenRecipient local exists solely to perform the external receiveApproval callback.
